text:
jen: Quick sync request — VaultGrid wants to coordinate a marketplace listing + joint announcement for their HSM-backed KMS with our SSO/SCIM integration. Short readiness check: certs, SCIM mapping, embargo window, marketing assets.

omar: Ill handle the integration side. SAML metadata exchange ✅, sign-in flows pass in staging. SCIM user/group updates are inconsistent — group name mismatch. KMS key-wrap tests ok against their simulator; need partner HSM cert for prod provisioning.

lucy: @jen we will upload production HSM cert today EOD. PR owner for announcement is @kevin.vg. Proposed announcement windows: May 9-13 or May 23-27. Any compliance blockers?

andrew: Security ask: what's the FIPS level, and can we review a minimal KMS policy snippet for inclusion in the compliance packet? Also confirm key export restrictions (no-export).

omar: Minimal KMS policy (example):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"Bool": {"kms:ExternalKey": "false"}} }
  ]
}
```
Partner confirms keys are non-exportable; enforced by HSM firmware.

lucy: HSMs are FIPS 140-2 Level 3, confirmed. We also have an attestation bundle; will upload to shared bucket after cert.

jen: On SCIM — Omar, can you paste a short repro of the failing mapping so partner can patch quickly? Keep it minimal.

omar: Repro (short):
1) Partner SCIM: create user with groups: ["engineering"]
2) Redwood SCIM mapping expects exact group names like "eng" -> role assignment fails
3) Result: role not assigned -> 403 on protected endpoints
Fix options: add alias mapping in Redwood or normalize incoming group names. Short-term workaround: partner will send aliases ENG/PM/SRE.

lucy: We'll provide alias mappings within 24 hrs. Legal confirmed NDA/embargo signed last week. @maria please confirm marketing lead time.

maria: Need 10 business days for co-marketing assets and copy review. May 9-13 is tight; May 23-27 is realistic. Also need high-res logos (SVG/PNG), screenshots, and a 60-90s demo video link (hosted).

partners-bot: Reminder: VaultGrid NDA status = signed. Certificate upload pending.

andrew: Please post the SHA256 of the HSM attestation once uploaded so we can include it in the compliance packet.

lucy: Attestation SHA256: a3f9d2b7c4e8b1d6f2a5c8e9b0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. Bundle will be at s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/vaultgrid/attestation.tar.gz.

jen: Action items: 
- VaultGrid (lucy): upload HSM cert + attestation bundle; provide SCIM alias list (EOD).
- Omar: prepare tiny SCIM mapping patch & repro steps, add role fallback in staging.
- Andrew: validate KMS policy + compliance packet after attestation upload.
- Maria: reserve May 23-27 for announcement; request assets from partner.
- Kevin (@kevin.vg): draft announcement copy once assets arrive.

lucy: Confirmed. Targeting May 23-27; assets by next Tue.

omar: I'll push the staging patch tonight and report verification here.

maria: Booking comms review slot for May 19.

jen: Thanks — re-check this thread once cert + aliases are live and well schedule a joint announcement dry-run.
